overview: Rockingham County VA SO uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence using license plate cameras (photos only / no videos) in public places without compromising on individual privacy. Rockingham County VA SO utilizes retroactive license plate search and vehicle descriptors to help solve crimes in our community after they have occurred. Additionally, Rockingham County VA SO utilizes real time alerting of "hotlist" vehicles to locate missing, wanted, and endangered persons that are entered into the Virginia State Police VCIN System (AMBER alerts, SENIOR alerts, etc.) In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
acceptable_use: License plate images are used for law enforcement purposes only and access is strictly governed by the Code of Virginia. All images are owned by Rockingham County VA SO and are never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid law enforcement reason and system access logs are stored.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
